explication: LangChain is an agent-engineering framework for composing LLM applications. The principal workflow is: an application receives user input, formats prompts, invokes a model, optionally retrieves augmented context or dispatches tools, parses the result, and returns an output. Core abstractions cover composition, messages, models, and parsers; surrounding layers provide retrieval/indexing, agent actions, persistence, serialization, callbacks, tracing, and compatibility integrations. Some subsystem links are inferred from documented APIs and sampled excerpts; unsampled implementations are represented conservatively.
